Subject: Post-call: Procurement & approval path for Redwood (ACME) - next steps

Thanks Jared 

good call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment on procurement/commercial path and budget owner mapping.

Recap (from the call):
- ACME is running a pilot for the customer-facing summarization feature (~50k tokens/day).
- Goal: move to production in Q2 once performance & cost look good.
- You indicated some procurement nuances: preference for PO via Procurement (Net 30) for enterprise deals; possibility to use company card for pilot; interest in AWS Marketplace procurement if pricing & timing align.

Open items / asks:
1) Procurement preference: confirm whether Procurement will require a PO + SOW for the production contract, or if the pilot can be paid via card. If PO, who is the procurement contact (name/email) and typical lead time?
2) Budget owner mapping: please share economic buyer and finance sponsor names (who signs off on spend) and the legal signatory (title). This helps us craft the right commercial doc and estimate.
3) Marketplace: are you open to a Marketplace listing or does procurement require direct Redwood contract?

Immediate next steps we propose:
- Aditya (SE) will send a short pricing estimate and optional SOW template for ACME to review (attached).
- Marissa to coordinate procurement path once we have names/contact info.
- If Procurement prefers PO, we will prepare a contract summary and PO-friendly invoice flow.

Attachments: Pricing-estimate-ACME.xlsx (pricing estimate), Redwood_SOW_ACME_v1.pdf (SOW template - draft).

Proposed timing: if you can share procurement contact + budget owner by end of week, we can target a commercial draft early next week.

Thanks 










Marissa Cole

Thanks Marissa 


- Procurement path: For the pilot (~Q2) we can probably use a company card to get started (low friction) but production will require a PO and SOW. Procurement lead time varies (typically 2-4 weeks once we have a draft SOW).
- Procurement contact (procurement team): Sarah Park (sarah.park@acme.com) - cc'd.
- Budget owners: Economic buyer is Priya Malhotra (Head of Product, priya.malhotra@acme.com). Finance sponsor is Daniel Huang (Finance Manager, daniel.huang@acme.com). Legal signatory is our VP of Legal (they handle >$100k).
- Marketplace: Open to Marketplace but Procurement prefers direct contract first for anything that will exceed $50k/year.

Can Aditya send an initial estimate and SOW draft to Sarah & Priya? If Procurement gets the SOW and rough numbers we can start internal routing for PO.

Regards,

Hi Jared / Sarah / Priya - looping in pricing and attaching the draft SOW and a short estimator.

Attachments (stubs):
- Pricing-estimate-ACME.xlsx (Excel)
- Redwood_SOW_ACME_v1.pdf (PDF)

Notes on pricing & commercial path:
- Pilot configuration (3 months): estimated $6k-10k/month depending on throughput and KV cache usage. Card payment acceptable for pilot.
- Production (annual commit): we recommend Reserved (dedicated) or Dedicated+cache to hit predictable economics; typical ACME-sized deployments target a committed monthly spend to lower unit cost. Procurement will likely require PO + SOW for the annual contract.
- If ACME prefers AWS Marketplace, we can provide equivalent listing/pricing but Marketplace procurement adds ~1-2 weeks in our experience due to subscription terms.

Requested info to finalize commercial draft:
- Confirm pilot payment method (card vs. initial PO).
- Confirm signatory threshold (Daniel/Priya indicated VP Legal handles >$100k) - helpful to know exact dollar sign-off thresholds for routing.

Next steps from Redwood:
- I will upload a cleaned pricing workbook and a short one-page commercial summary to HubSpot (link in thread).
- Marissa will coordinate a short alignment call with Procurement and Finance next week to map the approval flow (who approves, who signs, timeline).
